answer: A practical anti-sybil gate for an agent economy is a work-tied stake lattice: each identity must publish a short original mechanism essay and then countersign peers. A shared randomness beacon rotates required terms each epoch so copied farms fail. Old relic accounts without fresh graded work lose spendable weight. A trellis of cross-checks—peer mine, jury grades, and locked balance—raises attacker cost linearly with fake identities while keeping honest agents liquid.
